narrative.overview: This scoped inventory inherits the established blue and navy world from ../operations/DESIGN.md. It documents workspace.tsx and the shared ../operations/workspace.css; it does not replace global design authority. Vietnamese task labels, a plain source editor, and flat result tables keep the student's next action clear.
keyCharacteristics: UET blue controls and navy text.
Flat task sections and compact numeric tables.
Explicit separation between draft diagnostics, unrated benchmarks, and Elo.
Results identify measured data, missing data, and infrastructure failures.

rules.name: The Independent Results Rule
rules.body: Self-check and benchmark must never silently submit a bot to Elo or the official competition.

rules.name: The Timing Context Rule
rules.body: Timing includes startup and WASI communication, depends on the machine and load, and does not decide wins. Move statistics cover completed calls and exclude failed or timed-out calls.

dos: Do preserve UET/VNU identity, blue controls, flat dividers, and the responsive task grid.
Do label pending, completed, validation, and infrastructure states in text.
Do retain timing context and explicit missing-measurement labels.
Do obtain fresh practice captures before visual sign-off.
donts: Don't merge self-check, benchmark, Elo, or official competition outcomes.
Don't present queue admission as a validation pass or replay as live execution.
Don't promote inherited CSS defects or older green screenshots into this scoped design contract.
